channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Robert Sarver | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Robert Sarver from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on David Stern, Robert Sarver
item.description:
In the midst of answering a question about whether he could ever imagine playing an NBA game in Las Vegas, Kerr said he heard about initial efforts to place a team in the desert two decades ago.

“Twenty-two years ago, I walked into (former NBA commissioner) David Stern’s office in New York with Robert Sarver,”

Steve Kerr on David Stern, Robert Sarver, Oct 14, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Mat Ishbia on Robert Sarver
item.description:
Mat Ishbia:

“I had dinner with Robert Sarver and wanted to understand about owning an NBA team. I’ve had dinners with a lot of NBA owners not with the goal of buying their team. Phoenix was the elite one and when it came up for sale, I wanted to make sure I was the next guy and and how could I do that and the way I started it is with the relationship. I had to meet him ... had dinner with him and talked to him about the organization, about being an NBA owner, the Phoenix market and understand those things. And so, we built a relationship from there. At the end of the day, you can build a lot of relationships, but I also paid the top price – by a lot.”

Mat Ishbia on Robert Sarver, Feb 7, 2023. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Sam Garvin on Robert Sarver
item.description:
Sam Garvin:

“I communicate with Robert regularly. The suspension bars him from being involved in any day-to-day contact with employees, coming on any NBA premises, anything like that, but there’s a mechanism allowable by the NBA where on ‘extraordinary items,’ if I need to, I can communicate with him. So we communicate regularly. I wouldn’t say it’s often, but regularly.”

Sam Garvin on Robert Sarver, Dec 11, 2022. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Adam Silver on Robert Sarver
item.description:
Silver stated he was not.

“Did I hear ever that Robert could be difficult to deal with? Sure,”

Adam Silver on Robert Sarver, Oct 22, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Marc Spears on Robert Sarver
item.description:
Deandre Ayton believes Phoenix Suns governor Robert Sarver is to blame for not initially receiving a max contract extension,as both Ramona Shelburne and Marc Spears of ESPN reported:

“I was told that it was Robert Sarver who didn't want to give him that fifth year, who wanted to save the money,”

Marc Spears on Robert Sarver, Sep 29, 2022. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: James Jones on Robert Sarver
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:James Jones on the Robert Sarver investigation:

“I think I'm in agreement with selling the team. I think that's the best outcome for everyone involved.”

James Jones on Robert Sarver, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Robert Sarver
item.description:
Statement from NBPA President CJ McCollum on Robert Sarver selling the Suns:

“We thank Mr. Sarver for making a swift decision that was in the best interest of our sports community.”

CJ McCollum on Robert Sarver, Sep 21, 2022. Source: Twitter @malika_andrews.

item.title: Draymond Green on Robert Sarver
item.description:
“Andso to think that someone like Robert Sarver, that is acting in that manner, can continue to represent us? That's bulls--t. You can't continue to represent way more people than yourself with those views,”

Draymond Green on Robert Sarver, Sep 21, 2022. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Robert Sarver
item.description:
“Frankly, most of the people that I have stayed in touch with and I speak with do not feel Robert displayed racism when we were there together,”

Steve Kerr on Robert Sarver, Sep 21, 2022. Source: San Jose Mercury-News.

item.title: Draymond Green on Robert Sarver
item.description:
Green said on his podcast.

“The Phoenix Suns will walk into the arena next year, he'll sit on the sideline and we'll just continue on playing. So the one thing that I am going to need is someone to explain to me why is it that it was OK to get rid of [LA Clippers owner Donald] Sterling, but it's not possible to force Robert Sarver to sell after what we read?”

Draymond Green on Robert Sarver, Sep 20, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Draymond Green on Robert Sarver
item.description:
“To think that someone like Robert Sarver that's acting in that manner can continue to represent us? That's bulls---,”

Draymond Green on Robert Sarver, Sep 20, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Steve Nash on Robert Sarver
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Steve Nash on #Suns owner Robert Sarver:

“It was sad to read. That hasn't been my experience with Robert. But I'm obviously very sensitive to those type of situations. So disappointing that that's out there.”

Steve Nash on Robert Sarver, Nov 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jahm Najafi on Robert Sarver
item.description:
Suns vice chairman Jahm Najafi is the team’s second-largest investor, USA TODAY has learned, and he released a strongly worded statement Thursday.

“I have been made aware of the allegations against Robert Sarver, the managing partner who runs the Phoenix Suns,”

Jahm Najafi on Robert Sarver, Nov 4, 2021. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Monty Williams on Robert Sarver
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty Williams on keeping the Suns focused despite what's going on with the impending Sarver story:

“I'm not gonna talk about any of that, and nothing will invade or erode our culture. That's something that we've said from Day 1.”

Monty Williams on Robert Sarver, Oct 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: James Jones on Robert Sarver
item.description:
“And Robert was a banker and a guy who knew finance. So there was a baseline interest on my part to understand what he did and understand who he is.”

James Jones on Robert Sarver, May 23, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Monty Williams on Robert Sarver
item.description:
“I want so badly, selfishly, to coach and lead a team to a certain level, but I do really want badly to see Mr. Sarver looked at differently,”

Monty Williams on Robert Sarver, Nov 21, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Ryan McDonough on Robert Sarver
item.description:
Former Suns GM Ryan McDonough on the goats anecdote:

“I feel bad for (Suns owner) Robert (Sarver) with how that part of the story at least is being portrayed. It was funny. It was a funny thing. He thought it was funny. I thought it was funny. Everybody who was in the building that day thought it was funny…It was not malicious. It was not mean spirited. It was a fraternity house prank and everybody in the building had a good laugh when it happened.”

Ryan McDonough on Robert Sarver, Mar 9, 2019. Source: Player.fm.

item.title: Steve Nash on Robert Sarver
item.description:
Steve Nash on the Suns:

“I'm business partners with their owner [Robert Sarver], we just acquired Real Mallorca, a Spanish soccer club. So we're in pretty regular contact, I've got a lot of friends there. I might be open to working for the Suns in the future. (...) I'm not ready to do it at this time.”

Steve Nash on Robert Sarver, Feb 10, 2016. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Ryan McDonough on Robert Sarver
item.description:
“That was part of my interview with [team owner Robert Sarver and president of basketball operations Lon Babby]. We discussed potential coaching candidates, and who we thought would be good fits, and we were in alignment on a lot of the names — most of the names. “So we have an initial list to go off of. We’ve received a good amount of interest from people all over the basketball world who want to be the coach of this storied franchise, and they see a great opportunity here. That’s my first order of business as the general manager, to find the best guy for that job.”

Ryan McDonough on Robert Sarver, May 10, 2013. Source: NBCSports.com.

item.title: Lon Babby on Robert Sarver
item.description:
“As time went on, [Suns owner] Robert Sarver was really good and said, 'We have to make a basketball decision that's best for our franchise.'”

Lon Babby on Robert Sarver, Oct 12, 2012. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Rick Welts on Robert Sarver
item.description:
outgoing Suns President and CEO Rick Welts said.

“But I'll tell you, the guy I worked for before him, David Stern, is off the charts when it comes to being hard to work for. Robert is a piece of cake. He's got a wonderful heart. He's got this thing about wanting to win that every fan should appreciate.”

Rick Welts on Robert Sarver, Sep 18, 2011. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Rick Welts on Robert Sarver
item.description:
“From the time I made my announcement in May, the Suns, and Robert in particular, have been unbelievably supportive.”

Rick Welts on Robert Sarver, Sep 10, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Bill Duffy on Steve Nash, Robert Sarver
item.description:
“He’s revered there. There is enough of a relationship between Steve Nash and the Suns that if something were to transpire we’d be sure Steve would be involved in the process. Sarver has called me to tell me that nothing is going on with Steve. “He’s everything. He’s the identity of the organization.”

Bill Duffy on Steve Nash, Robert Sarver, Dec 19, 2010. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Lon Babby on Steve Kerr, Robert Sarver
item.description:
Lon Babby:

“It happened in a bizarre way. I had known [Suns owner] Robert Sarver through my dealings with Grant, and when Steve Kerr decided to leave [as Suns GM last spring] I told Grant that it would be important for us to try to participate, if welcomed, in some kind of search for the general manager -- to the extent that Robert was willing to hear a player's point of view, I was happy to vet candidates with him.”

Lon Babby on Steve Kerr, Robert Sarver, Dec 17, 2010. Source: SI.com.
